title: 고등ㆍ평생교육지원특별회계법 / queue:ADDENDUM:21227:20251223:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Addendum <Act No. 21227, December 23, 2025>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. Provided, however, that the amended provisions of Article 6 (2) and Article 2 of these Addenda shall enter into force on January 1, 2026.

Article 2 (Amendment of Other Acts)
Part of the Local Education Finance Subsidy Act shall be amended as follows:
In Article 3 (2) 2, the phrase "out of the revenue amount" (Korean source: "세입액 중") shall be replaced with "out of the revenue amount, the amount prescribed in Article 6 (1) of the Special Account for Support for Higher and Lifelong Education Act, and" (Korean source: "세입액 중 「고등ㆍ평생교육지원특별회계법」 제6조제1항에서 정하는 금액 및"); and "the amount and the amount prescribed in Article 6 (1) of the Special Account for Support for Higher and Lifelong Education Act" (Korean source: "금액 및 「고등ㆍ평생교육지원특별회계법」 제6조제1항에서 정하는 금액") shall be replaced with "the amount" (Korean source: "금액").
